messages:
Maya (Security): FYI customer asked for BYOK + HSM-proxy model for prod with cross-region fallback. We need to agree on minimal operator RBAC, required audit fields/retention for SOC2/PCI, and an incident quarantine flow for import failures. @Ibrahim @Priya take a look.

Ibrahim (Infra): Agree. Principle: operators never get key material. We should use an import-only pattern: tenant generates key and we call kms:ImportKeyMaterial into a per-tenant key. Minimal actions: kms:ImportKeyMaterial, kms:DescribeKey, kms:CreateGrant (scoped), kms:Encrypt/Decrypt only if customer permits. Deny schedule/delete and denial for altering audit config.

Ibrahim (Infra): Quick policy sketch (high-level): allow ImportKeyMaterial + DescribeKey on arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/tenant-*, allow CreateGrant only with Condition on grant tokens and principal. Explicit deny for ScheduleKeyDeletion, DisableKey.

Priya (Compliance): For SOC2 baseline keep 12 months of events searchable; recommend default 24 months for BYOK customers unless contract says otherwise. For PCI, log key lifecycle events for 3 years is safer. Required log fields: timestamp, key_id, action, requesting_principal, request_id/correlation_id, source_ip, result (success/fail), attestation_token_id, firmware_version (if available). Do NOT log key material or anything that could be reversed.

Maya (Security): Agreed on fields. Also capture request_payload_hash (SHA256) to bind requests to payload without exposing contents. Any audit export to customer must be sanitized and include only metadata + signed attestation statements.

audit-bot: Onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/byok-onboard-check (includes RBAC matrix, evidence template, and required audit fields).

Alex (oncall): What's the failover/incident path? If we detect import integrity mismatch or HSM firmware alert, do we auto-revoke grants, quarantine keys, or pause traffic?

Ibrahim (Infra): Operational proposal: on integrity mismatch -> pause new imports for tenant, flip key to read-only/quarantine state (no new grants), notify sec+infra oncall, create ticket. Do NOT auto-revoke existing customer grants unless we detect compromise via active misuse or exfil patterns. Preserve full audit bundle and HSM attestation blobs.

Priya (Compliance): Add requirement: two-person review (security + infra) required to move key out of quarantine or to approve cross-region re-import. Log the approval with justification. For legal requests, provide signed attestation + policy snapshot; avoid sharing internal ARNs unless under NDA.

Maya (Security): For cross-region fallback, prefer an explicit re-import path: replicate metadata and require customer-signed attestation to import into secondary region HSM. Automation allowed only if attestation verified and a flag set in customer's contract.

Ibrahim (Infra): Proxy config sketch: mtls enabled, attestation_ttl short (5m), allowed_actions limited, audit forwarding off by default but can be turned on per-tenant to an S3/Audit API with encryption and restricted retention. We'll emit attest_token_id in logs.

Maya (Security): RBAC change process: any new KeyCustodian binding must have PR with policy diff, two approvers, and auditor evidence attached. Changes to audit retention must be approved by compliance and recorded.

Priya (Compliance): I'll draft retention matrix (SOC2 default=12m, SOC2 strict=24m contract opt-in, PCI critical=36m for key lifecycle events). Also will clarify what counts as key lifecycle events.

Alex (oncall): I'll add a simulated import-failure drill to the oncall playbook and validate alerting routing next week. We should test quarantine -> manual restore path.

Maya (Security): Sounds good. Action items: Ibrahim to draft minimal role + proxy config, Priya to produce retention matrix and legal note about ARNs, Alex to schedule drill, Maya to write the two-person review doc and incident quarantine steps. Ping me when drafts ready.

Ibrahim (Infra): Will put up a draft policy and proxy snippet tomorrow.

Priya (Compliance): Will share matrix and raise legal question about ARN disclosure.

Maya (Security): Thanks team. We'll loop legal after Priya posts the matrix.
